items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: This is a group that was formed by Oliver Jackson, Bill Pimperton and myself after we left Earl in July of 1969.

ctx.x: Before you tell that story I just want to acknowledge the presence of your partner in crime and in time, and part of your organization, the JPJ, Bill Pemberton just walked in, so we want to note that Bill is here, and in case Bill wants to ask us some questions to verify some things with us, we'll certainly welcome that in.
Mr. William Pemberton, my colleague and dear friend is here, and this happens to be his birthday, ladies and gentlemen.
